description: This file contains test cases for quantized functional operations in PyTorch, including tests for relu, convolution APIs (1D, 2D, 3D), and grid sampling. It uses unittest style and hypothesis for parameterized testing. It is part of PyTorch's internal tests for quantization functionalities.

classes.name: TestQuantizedFunctionalOps
classes.description: Test case class for quantized functional operations in PyTorch, including relu, convolution, and grid sampling methods. It extends QuantizationTestCase and contains multiple parameterized test methods.
